notes.title: Open your hands so I may plop in a nice frog game inspired by Doom and Resident Evil
notes.content:
"What if Resident Evil and Frogger had a boomer shooter baby?," teases the trailer blurb for FPS Frog Legs. Stop, stop. You had me at Frog. Then you had me again when I saw the frog using a super shotgun, and then once again when they used a BFG. Then, inconceivably, you had me twice more reading the Steam page. Once when I learned the game was about 40 minutes long, and then again when I noticed it costs two quid. Trailer? Yes. I already said there was. Please, keep up.

Read more

notes.title: Pre-release Update
notes.content:
Hello!
To those playing the pre-release build, a new feature has been added:

Once you beat the game, you now will have access to a chapter select menu providing an easy way to go back and find anything (secrets???) you may have missed!

This will work even if you previously beat the game, unless you began a new game before this update. If you began a new game already after beating the game, and would like to skip to the end, email me at elliottdahlegames@gmail.com and I will help you enable chapter select.

In addition, the main menu is now accessible from the pause menu.

Thank you and RIBBIT AND TEAR!
-Elliott
